single_page_centered.text: centered upper reading area, balanced short lines, natural quiet background
single_page_centered.scene: prominent people and narrative action below the measured text, with natural proportions

open_book_centered.source: two finished square pages placed side by side
open_book_centered.text: each page owns its own centered verses; keep inner margins clear of the gutter
open_book_centered.scene: coherent setting, palette, wardrobe and cast, with different sequential actions

open_book_headed.source: two finished square pages placed side by side
open_book_headed.text: optional page heading above left-aligned body; use only when explicitly selected
open_book_headed.scene: the same scene-world and cast, with meaningful changes in gesture and action

principles: Use these examples for composition only. Original project photos alone define identity and age.
Never copy example names, faces, verses, religion, beach, furniture or props into an unrelated project.
Use the layout selected by the current project. Do not combine centered verses and a headed left-aligned layout in the same page.
Fit the exact approved copy and measure its ink bounds before composing artwork; keep a visible gap to heads and important gestures.
Keep people prominent and proportional. Do not crop feet, hands or narrative action merely to open space for text.
Continue the setting naturally behind the text; do not add opaque bands or artificial gradients.
Discreet foliage, sky, clouds or other theme-appropriate background details may surround text if legibility and subject separation remain intact.
Keep wardrobe, cast and the chosen scene-world consistent; vary actions and expressions according to each passage.
Only explicitly requested narrative actions and essential objects are mandatory. Do not reject an image for missing incidental objects from an example or identity photograph.
Flat source art must have no lettering or physical-book borders. Apply approved text deterministically, then compose the physical open-book presentation separately.
Examples inform layout, not a requirement to change the selected realistic/cartoon style.
Catalog examples define visual standards, never the new story cast, names, words or props. Match the selected finish; do not force every theme into one watercolor or computer template.
A held book must have visible hardback boards, a hinge/spine, page-block thickness and natural hand contact; never resemble a loose sheet or pasted card.
Spine colors and texture continue the actual project cover. Do not add a generic beige side strip unrelated to the artwork.

family_soft.design: Soft illustrated surroundings, lifelike recognizable people, generous natural quiet reading space; cover title integrated in the upper-right scene.

adventure_vivid.design: Luminous vivid realistic scenes, prominent meaningful action, title in upper-center natural space; separate short passages on each page.

cartoon.design: Premium soft cartoon finish with rounded, consistent characters. Quiet illustrated background supports legible text; keep all project identity cues.
